logo_alt: Vilna logo: a swallow flying out of a brushstroke circle
gloxi_desc: Gloxi is an AI assistant for GNOME that runs on your own computer and acts only with your permission. A preview for testers.
gloxi_lead: An AI assistant for GNOME that talks to a model on your own computer and acts only with your permission.
gloxi_local_p: A small language model runs on your computer. Without the cloud, nothing you write leaves it.
gloxi_cloud_p: You can connect any OpenAI-compatible service with your own key. Personal data is masked before it leaves your computer.
gloxi_asks_p: Gloxi works only in the folders you choose, and only through Herkos, which shows what will change, asks you and keeps a log.
gloxi_warn_h: An honest word about the preview
gloxi_warn_p: This is an early version for testing. On a regular Linux, Herkos runs in the same sandbox as Gloxi, so the protection is weaker than it will be in Vilna OS, where Herkos is a separate system service. Do not give Gloxi folders you cannot afford to lose, and keep backups.
gloxi_need_os: Linux with GNOME and Flatpak (openSUSE Aeon, Fedora Workstation, Ubuntu with Flatpak and so on).
gloxi_need_cpu: A 64-bit Intel or AMD processor; a graphics card is optional.
gloxi_need_ram: At least 8 GB of RAM, 16 GB is better; about 3 GB of free space for the model.
gloxi_install_soon: Gloxi 0.1 comes out at the end of January 2027. Until then you can build it from source.
gloxi_step_download: Download gloxi.flatpak and gloxi.flatpak.sha256 from the latest release:
gloxi_step_verify: Check that the file is complete and has not been replaced:
gloxi_step_install: Install the GNOME runtime from Flathub (if you do not have it yet) and Gloxi itself:
gloxi_step_run: Start Gloxi from the app menu or with flatpak run io.github.stdenis1980.Gloxi. On the first start Gloxi asks before it downloads the model (Qwen3 4B, about 2.5 GB) and checks its checksum. Nothing about you is sent.
gloxi_remove: To remove it: flatpak uninstall --user io.github.stdenis1980.Gloxi (add --delete-data to erase the model and settings too).
gloxi_feedback_p: We most want to know what worked, what did not, and where Gloxi surprised you. Please mention your distribution, how much memory you have and what you asked.
gloxi_feedback_public: Feedback is public. Do not paste personal data, passwords or the contents of your files. Report vulnerabilities privately — see security.txt.
gloxi_footer: Gloxi is part of Vilna OS
privacy_desc: What the Vilna OS site, the feedback form, crash reports, Gloxi and Vilna OS do with your data, and your rights under the GDPR.
privacy_lead: In short: this site collects nothing about you. Feedback and crash reports reach us only when you choose to send them, are kept for 90 days, and we never store IP addresses.
privacy_site_1: No cookies, analytics, counters, ads, embedded videos or social buttons.
privacy_site_2: All fonts, icons and styles are served by this site; your browser does not contact other servers.
privacy_site_3: The site is hosted in Europe. The host briefly sees the technical details of each request (as every web server does) but does not keep your IP address in its logs.
privacy_github_p: Gloxi's files and code are on GitHub. When you go there or download a release, the GitHub privacy statement applies. Feedback in GitHub Issues is public.
privacy_gloxi_1: By default Gloxi uses a model on your computer, and your conversations do not leave it.
privacy_gloxi_2: The model is downloaded only after you agree; only the request for the file is sent.
privacy_gloxi_3: You turn the cloud on yourself, with your own key for a service you choose. Personal data is masked on the device before it is sent. What that service does with the masked text is up to its own policy.
privacy_gloxi_4: Gloxi sends no usage statistics. Feedback and crash reports leave your computer only with your consent, as described above.

blavet_desc: Blavet is the name of the first Vilna release: a cornflower and a kingfisher.
blavet_lead: The first release of Vilna is called Blavet. In Valencian the word means both the cornflower and the kingfisher, a small blue bird with an orange breast.
blavet_mark_alt: The Blavet mark: a kingfisher looking out of a hollow
blavet_name_p: Vilna releases are named after flowers. The cornflower and the kingfisher share the colours of Vilna: blue, orange and gold. Every release has its own mark, while the Vilna logo and the Gloxi owl stay the same.
blavet_look_p: The light style is the default, with the Sun wallpaper; the dark style is one switch away. The Blavet wallpaper turns the wing of the kingfisher into a Petrykivka ornament.
blavet_in_gloxi: The assistant that runs a language model on your own computer and acts only with your permission.
blavet_in_herkos: The guard between Gloxi and your system: it shows what will change, asks you and keeps a log.
blavet_in_updates: Based on openSUSE Aeon: the system updates itself in the background, and every update can be rolled back.
blavet_when_p: Blavet is in development. The alpha is planned by January 2028. You can follow the work in the open code.
contact: the feedback form (leave an email if you want a reply)
fb_desc: Tell us what went wrong in Vilna OS or Gloxi, or what you would like to see. No account needed.
fb_lead: Tell us what went wrong, what you would like to see, or anything else. No account needed, and we read every message.
fb_text_hint: What did you do, what did you expect and what happened instead? Which program and version, if you know. Any of our ten languages is fine.
fb_contact_hint: Only if you want an answer. We keep it apart from your message, never publish it and delete it together with the message.
fb_publish: You may publish my message as a public issue after review, without my email.
fb_note: Please do not include passwords or other people's personal details. The message is kept on our server in the EU for 90 days; your IP address is not stored. More in Privacy.
fb_err_text: The message was empty or longer than 8000 characters, so it was not sent. Sorry, the text was not kept: please write it again.
fb_err_contact: That email address does not look right, so the message was not sent. Please write it again, and leave the email empty if you do not need a reply.
fb_err_kind: Please choose what the message is about and send it again.
fb_err_server: Our server could not save the message. Please try again later, or use GitHub Issues below.
fb_alt_p: If you prefer to write in public, use GitHub Issues. Report vulnerabilities privately: see security.txt.
fbt_p: We read every message. If you left an email, we may reply within a few days. The message is deleted from our server after 90 days.
legal_desc: Who runs vilnaos.com, the licences of Vilna OS and the names it uses.
legal_lead: Who is behind this site and what you may do with what is on it.
legal_project_p: Vilna OS, Gloxi and Herkos are free software. Their code is in a public repository under GPL-3.0-or-later or Apache-2.0; each file says which. The code and text of this site are under GPL-3.0-or-later.
legal_marks_p: The names Vilna OS, Gloxi and Herkos and their logos identify this project. Please do not use them in a way that suggests that your product is ours. Vilna OS is based on openSUSE but is not made or endorsed by the openSUSE Project or SUSE; openSUSE is a trademark of SUSE LLC.
legal_host_p: This site is hosted by statichost.eu in the EU. Feedback and crash reports go to our own server, reports.vilnaos.com, at IONOS in an EU data centre.
legal_warranty_p: Vilna OS and Gloxi are provided as they are, without warranty, as their licences say. Previews are for testing: keep backups of anything important.
legal_links_p: This site links to other sites, such as GitHub. We do not control them, and their own terms and privacy policies apply.
privacy_who_p: This is the controller under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) for the data described on this page.
privacy_site_4: The Gloxi domains (gloxi.eu and others) only redirect to this site through bunny.net (Slovenia), with request logs turned off.
privacy_fb_1: You can send feedback with the form on this site, and later from Gloxi or the Feedback window in Vilna OS. We receive what you wrote, the type, the language and, only if you choose to add them, your email, details about your system and the numbers of your crash reports.
privacy_fb_2: It goes to our server reports.vilnaos.com, run at IONOS in an EU data centre under a data processing agreement.
privacy_fb_3: The server does not store IP addresses, request headers or access logs. To stop abuse it counts requests per address in memory for one hour only.
privacy_fb_4: Before storing, the server removes email addresses, IP and network addresses, file paths and long numbers from the text a second time.
privacy_fb_5: Your email is kept apart from the message, used only to reply, never published, and deleted together with the message.
privacy_fb_6: Feedback is deleted after 90 days. Only we can read it. It becomes a public GitHub issue only if you ticked that box, after we review it, and without your email.
privacy_crash_1: Vilna OS and Gloxi send crash reports only if you agree. They ask once (in the installer, or on the first start of Gloxi), and you can change the answer at any time in the settings or by telling Gloxi.
privacy_crash_2: A report says which program crashed, its version, the kind of crash and where in the code it happened. It never contains a memory dump, file contents, file paths, user or computer names, network names, IP addresses or the text of error messages.
privacy_crash_3: There is no permanent device identifier. Each report has a random number that stays on your device; with it the device can delete its reports from our server at any time.
privacy_crash_4: Reports are deleted after 90 days. Only a counter per kind of crash remains (program, version, how many times), with nothing about you or your device.
privacy_os_1: Vilna OS downloads updates from openSUSE servers and their mirrors, and apps from the stores you use, such as Flathub; their own privacy policies apply.
privacy_basis_1: Feedback and crash reports: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw it at any time; that does not affect what was sent before.
privacy_basis_2: Delivering this site safely: our legitimate interest in running it (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). The host does not keep IP addresses.
privacy_proc_p: We do not sell or share data. These providers handle it on our behalf, all in the EU:
privacy_proc_2: IONOS SE (Germany): the server reports.vilnaos.com, in an EU data centre.
privacy_proc_3: BunnyWay d.o.o. (bunny.net, Slovenia): redirects of the Gloxi domains.
privacy_rights_p: You have the right to access, correct and delete your data, to restrict or object to its processing, to data portability, and to withdraw consent.
privacy_delete_p: To delete your reports, use Vilna OS or Gloxi: they send the numbers of your reports, and the server deletes them at once. If you left an email with feedback, write to us from it and we will delete that feedback. Without an email we cannot tell which feedback is yours, because nothing links it to you; it is deleted after 90 days anyway.
privacy_complain_p: You can complain to the data protection authority of your country, or to the Spanish authority, the AEPD.
privacy_changes_p: When something changes, we update this page; its full history is in the public repository. Last updated: 12 November 2026.
